description: This PHP source file defines the class RequestForwardableException within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends the base Exception class and implements HttpExceptionInterface, providing additional properties and methods to handle exceptions related to forwarding requests, including controller information, attributes, query parameters, status code, and headers.

classes.name: RequestForwardableException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to handle request forwarding-related errors within the OrangeHRM system. It stores controller, attributes, query, status code, and headers, and provides getter and setter methods for these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RequestForwardableException with specified controller, attributes, and query parameters.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Returns the controller associated with the exception.

methods.name: setController
methods.description: Sets the controller associated with the exception.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes array associated with the exception.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes array for the exception.
